fields.acceptance: A unit test of the shared helper creates, under a temp root, a folder with the prefix back-dated over an hour (os.Chtimes), a fresh one with the prefix and an old one with another prefix, runs the sweep and asserts only the stale prefixed folder is gone; each of internal/api, internal/index and internal/slice TestMain and internal/quiettest's turn-taking call it for their own prefix before making a folder; make check passes
fields.statement: A test run that is killed before its cleanup (a go test timeout) leaves no lasting litter: each package that makes a fixed-prefix temp folder (internal/api rhiza-api-budget-*, internal/index rhiza-index-budget-*, internal/slice rhiza-slice-budget-*, internal/quiettest rhiza-quiet-*) removes, when it starts, the folders under os.TempDir() with its prefix whose modification time is older than an hour, through one shared helper
